A '''Star Temple''', a structure built by the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was located in the [[Yhuli system/Legends|Yhuli system]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Star Temple]] was an unrecognizable ruin that was only identified after archaeological studies.<ref name="Mission" />
